_about: t21 (D51): t20_base.json (the t20 network: dual camera features, L4 lane branch, motion block, delta slots, 1 m centre-line head, hygiene fixes, split 'large') warm-started from the finished baseline runs/t20_base_s0 (init_from: its EMA weights, optimiser and schedule fresh; cam_buffer adds no parameter, so no key is fresh) and trained 1500 steps at lr 1e-4 with warm-up 100, ema 0.99 and a validation every 750 steps (t20_base: 6000 steps, lr 3e-4, ema 0.999, validation every 2000); everything else as t20_base.json (seed 0, batch 2, accum 3 (the chain of 9 recurrent calls does not fit in GPU memory at batch 3: estimated 12.7 GB against about 10.9 GB free, the t20 peak was 9.67 GB; the same 6 clips per step; the other arms keep batch 3, accum 2: a named confound of the card), clips of 3 keyframes with the state kept in the graph, flip augmentation). The arms of the experiment (pair, pair4, rec, ctl) differ in model.cam_buffer, n_cam and cam_stride only: model.cam_buffer 'recurrent', n_cam 3: the temporal block's own output of the previous frame is the buffer (each frame is lifted once and fused with the previous fused state, moved by the block's splat and velocity head); a batch unrolls its three frames oldest to newest and continues from the previous keyframe's buffer (the frame chain at stride 2 is gapless), so the training chain is up to 9 frames deep while a stream is unbounded. The motion block reads the current and the previous raw BEV (0.167 s).
name: t21_rec
